user.title: Sign in to mojeodpadky.cz
user.description: Use the same credentials as on the website. The integration finds your municipality itself.

schedules.title: Choose schedules
schedules.description:
Municipality: {obec}

Selected schedules will be followed on the website for you. Unchecking one unsubscribes it.

reauth_confirm.title: New password for mojeodpadky.cz
reauth_confirm.description: The server rejected the stored password for account {username}. It was probably changed on the website – enter the new one.

error.slug_not_found: Signed in, but the account's municipality could not be determined. Please report it on GitHub.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.reauth_successful: The password has been saved and the integration reloaded.

init.title: Select schedules
init.description: Checked schedules are the ones currently subscribed on the website. Checking a schedule subscribes it there, unchecking unsubscribes it.

abort.not_loaded: The service is not loaded right now (the website is unavailable or a new password is needed). Settings can be changed once it loads.
